translations.web: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king’s merchants purchased them from Kue.
translations.bsb: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and Kue; the royal merchants purchased them from Kue.
translations.kjv: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
translations.asv: And the horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt; the king's merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.
